summary: Treasure's boss-rush-heavy late Mega Drive run-and-gun, originally released in Japan/PAL territories and later preserved through Treasure Box, Virtual Console, Steam, Nintendo Classics, and mini-console routes.

entries.title: Alien Soldier
entries.definitive_edition: Sega Ages 2500: Gunstar Heroes Treasure Box

emulation.emulator: PCSX2 for Treasure Box; Nintendo Switch Online or Genesis Plus GX for single-version play
emulation.notes: Use Treasure Box for archive comparison, Switch Online for quick current access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Mega Drive presentation with compilation/emulator filters.

primary.version: Sega Ages 2500: Gunstar Heroes Treasure Box
primary.why: The Japanese PS2 Treasure Box is the most complete official route because it includes the Japanese and PAL versions, video filter options, and an expert recorded full playthrough, while the Switch Online and Steam releases are easier single-version access paths.
primary.how_to_play: Play Sega Ages 2500: Gunstar Heroes Treasure Box on PS2 or PCSX2 for full archive coverage. If you only want to play the game, use Nintendo Switch Online, an owned Steam/Sega Classics copy, or Sega Genesis Mini 2.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is official emulation inside a compilation, not a remaster; no Vectorman-style sequel exists for Alien Soldier.
